questions.question: A payment row needs to show that the payment went through. Which Coin component marks it?

required: Places it beside the row title

withPack.answer: A Badge labelled Paid beside the row title, with Semantic Intent System and AppearanceSystem positive.

withoutPack.answer: A green chip at the end of the row that says Payment successful.
withoutPack.notes: Picked a generic chip and wrote a sentence.

questions.question: Configure a Badge that tells someone a payment failed.

validAnswers: Badge with Semantic Intent System, AppearanceSystem negative, and a short label
required: A short label such as Failed

withoutPack.answer: <Badge label="Payment failed, please try again" color="red" />
failed: A short label such as Failed

questions.question: Add a status with an icon before its label to a Card row.

validAnswers: A Badge in the row's HStack, with an Icon in leading that gets the Badge's modes
required: The Icon gets the Badge's modes
recommended: The Badge sits beside the row title

failed: The Icon gets the Badge's modes
withPack.notes: Read the entry but left the Icon without modes.

failed: The Icon gets the Badge's modes
withoutPack.notes: Used a View and an icon prop that Badge does not have.

questions.question: Give an interactive Badge a screen-reader label that differs from its visible text.

withPack.answer: Badge ignores accessibilityLabel, so it can't differ from the visible text. Write a visible label that makes sense on its own, and report the gap.

withoutPack.answer: Set accessibilityLabel="Open payment details" on the Badge.
